title: monardella macrantha subsp. eumacrantha
intro: Monardella macrantha subsp. eumacrantha, commonly known as Purple Mountain Monardella, is a perennial plant species in the mint family, characterized by its fragrant flowers and woody stems. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Monardella macrantha subsp. eumacrantha include antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory actions, making it a potential remedy for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
